data.name: Riham
data.gender_notes: Riham is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A gentle and soothing rain that nourishes the earth. The name Riham carries the meaning “Soft Rain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Riham usually hope their child will grow to embody soft rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Riham is a symbol of Allah's mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Riham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft Rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riham total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ريحم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من رحم، يعني الرحمة والمودة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريحم مشتق من الفعل رحم، وهو يعني الرحمة والمودة والتعاطف. وقد وردت كلمة رحمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيُسَبِحُ الرَّحْمَنُ إِذَا هُوَ رَزَقَكُمْ' (الأنعام: 13). ويعتبر اسم ريحم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وروحية، وهو شائع الاستخدام في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ریحم
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریحم نام کا مطلب رحمت اور مودت سے ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفعل رحم سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رحمت کرنا یا مہربانی کرنا۔ اسلامی تقالید میں رحمت اور مودت کی اہمیت بہت زیادہ ہے، اور یہ نام ان خوبیوں کی عکاسی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ریحم
in_hindi.long_meaning: ریحم नाम का अर्थ दया और प्रेम से है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया रिहम से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दया करना या प्रेम करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में दया और प्रेम का बहुत महत्व है, और यह नाम इन गुणों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ريحم
in_pashto.long_meaning: ريحم نوم د رحمت او مودت څخه دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل رحيم څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د رحمت او مودت معنی ورکوي. په اسلامي دود کې رحمت او مودت ډير اهميت لري، او دا نوم دغو ځانګړتيو ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Riham
in_english.long_meaning: The name Riham originates from the Arabic root 'r-h-m', which means 'to have mercy' or 'to be compassionate'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'rahma', meaning 'mercy' or 'compassion'. In Islamic tradition, mercy and compassion are essential qualities, and the name Riham reflects these attributes. The name has been used in various Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, and Turkish communities, symbolizing kindness, empathy, and benevolence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Riham carries a gentle, soothing, and calming meaning. In Islamic culture, water is a symbol of life, purity, and blessings from Allah. The gentle rain signifies renewal, growth, and rejuvenation. The name can be understood as a reminder of divine blessings and mercy upon people and their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Riham can be connected to various aspects of Islamic teachings. For one, it can represent Allah's infinite mercy and compassion for Humanity. Mercy is a central theme in the Islamic faith, and the name Riham serves as a reminder of this ongoing divine blessing. It can also be seen as a manifestation of the gentleness and compassion of Allah towards His creation.
